mapper.insert: insert into pms_device (sn, device_code, product_id, shelf_no, online_status, last_sync_time, last_heartbeat, battery, firmware, abnormal_flag, abnormal_remark, bind_time, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{sn}, #{deviceCode}, #{productId}, #{shelfNo}, #{onlineStatus}, #{lastSyncTime}, #{lastHeartbeat}, #{battery}, #{firmware}, #{abnormalFlag}, #{abnormalRemark}, #{bindTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
